description:
The source-comment sweep closes with a record comparing each crate's comment share before and after, listing every justified pattern match, and naming the tracked issues that now hold removed planned-work statements.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The completion record states each crate's comment share after the sweep by the same command as the baseline, beside the baseline figures.
- [hard] REQ-02: A case-insensitive grep of `crates/` comment lines for the sweep pattern below returns only lines that the record lists, each with a one-line justification.

  ```text
  non-goal|out of scope|not in scope|future work|deferred to|follow-on|phase [a-e]\b|wave [a-z0-9]|(task|issue|story) `?[0-9a-f]{8}|previously|no longer|legacy|migrat
  ```

- [hard] REQ-03: The record lists every tracked issue created or matched for a removed planned, deferred or out-of-scope statement.
title: Close the sweep with the after census and justification list
